# Bites for the Book

*Edwina has stitched too many rat bites this season. She wants the drains below the lanes thinned, and the tails brought back so she can measure the bites against them.*

## Objectives

- Defeat 30 [Drain Rat](../monsters/drain_rat.md) in [The Old Drains](../maps/old_drains.md)
- Bring 10 [Drain Rat Tail](../items/drain_rat_tail.md) (taken)

## Rewards

- 3,200 EXP
- 440 mesos
- [Orange Potion](../items/orange_potion.md) x10
- +15 standing with Selsior
- +80 standing with [Edwina](../npcs/edwina.md)
